note: Shared between shoephone (Rust daemon) and shoephone-app (Swift approver). Both derive the scope challenge for trust and apply grants independently; each repo has a test asserting its own implementation reproduces every vector here. Edit in the daemon repo and copy to the app; scripts/e2e.sh in the app fails if the two copies differ.
derivation: challenge = base64url(sha256(bytes_to_sign)), no padding. addresses = lowercase hex sha256 of the address text: one '<action> <address>\n' line per change, in order.
